title: Join the columns
hints: Do it in two passes: first work out exactly how many bytes the result needs, then allocate once and fill it.
The size is: the sum of every part's length, plus `strlen(sep)` for each gap between parts (there are `count - 1` gaps when `count > 0`), plus 1 for the `'\0'`. With `count == 0` that's just 1 byte.
Keep a write cursor `char *p = out;`. For each part: if `i > 0`, `memcpy(p, sep, sep_len); p += sep_len;` then `memcpy` the part and advance. Finish with `*p = '\0';`.
